verdict.rationale: The Crossplane CLI documents rendering/testing Composition Functions offline without a cluster (crossplane-docs-7) and troubleshooting of Compositions/Composite Resources (crossplane-docs-8), which supports pre-apply validation, but there is no documented auto-format command or explicit 'validate' step comparable to `terraform fmt`/`validate`, and Crossplane has no 'plan' phase to validate before. missing for 10: dedicated config auto-formatter, explicit schema validation command, and any 'plan' equivalent to validate against.
